request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

parsed.title: Tunis and Sfax Core DNS Degradation Incident Report
parsed.root_cause_summary: A software upgrade patch applied to CORE-DNS-01 caused core DNS resolution latency and failure rates, leading to customer inability to load web pages and apps.
parsed.confidence_reason: Directly evidenced by change CHG-2026-0001, subsequent DNS timeout alarms, and core node anomalies matching the customer impact window, while external events and maintenance windows were ruled out.
parsed.impact_summary: Customers in Tunis and Sfax experienced web and app loading failures due to DNS degradation between 12:00 and 14:00.

timeline.event: Software upgrade patch CHG-2026-0001 applied on CORE-DNS-01.
Core DNS degradation alert ALR-0001 started, showing query_success_pct drop and resolution_ms spike.
Major alarm ALM-000003 raised for DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE on CORE-DNS-01.

findings.claim: A software upgrade was performed on CORE-DNS-01 at 2026-09-02 11:00.
A core DNS anomaly occurred beginning at 2026-09-02 12:00, with query success dropping to 89% and resolution latency spiking to 120ms.
Major alarm DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 2026-09-02 12:30.
No external events were recorded in region TUN between 2026-09-02 11:00 and 15:00.
No maintenance window was scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents during the incident window.

hypotheses.reason: The software upgrade CHG-2026-0001 directly preceded the DNS degradation anomalies and alarm on CORE-DNS-01.
No maintenance windows were scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 or its parents.

dismissed_signals.reason: No maintenance window was active or scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 during the incident window.
No external events were reported in region TUN that could account for the issue.

recommended_actions: Review software upgrade patch procedures and pre-deployment validation for CORE-DNS-01.
Implement enhanced health checks following core DNS changes.
